# DisplayX

> A lightweight, wallpaper-first Home screen for Android TV and Google TV, built on the cleanyourtv launcher (MIT).
> Home measured 43 MB on a 1.8 GB TV. It has a frosted glass clock, a moving glass focus, a wallpaper mode,
> Continue watching, and a balanced wallpaper slideshow. No network use unless the owner sets a weather location.
> It installs beside the cleanyourtv launcher under its own app ID.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): features, build, install and permissions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): steps for coding agents, the tested-on table, settings keys, and what not to do
- [theme/config.json](theme/config.json): the default theme
- [source/displayx.patch](source/displayx.patch): the change against cleanyourtv commit 718f98c9

## Facts

- Platforms: Android TV and Google TV, minSdk 26. Tested on Google TV 14 (MediaTek, 1.8 and 2.4 GB RAM), Android TV 11 (OnePlus, 2 GB) and an Android TV 8 emulator.
- Install: `install.ps1` (Windows) or `install.sh` (macOS, Linux).
- Permissions: `READ_MEDIA_IMAGES` or, on Android 8-12, `READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` (wallpapers), `READ_TV_LISTINGS` (Continue watching), `INTERNET` (Continue watching
  poster images from the streaming apps' own addresses, and the opt-in weather), and an accessibility helper (only on TVs whose Home button skips the chosen Home).
- Undo: `adb uninstall <app id>`.
